page: Amazon Web Services c6id.32xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the AWS Nitro System and powered by the 3rd Generation Intel Xeon Scalable processor (Ice Lake 8375C). Operating on the x86_64 architecture, the instance provides 128 vCPUs across 64 physical cores with multithreading enabled at a clock speed of 3.5 GHz. It includes hardware acceleration support for cryptographic routines and vector operations through AVX-512 and AVX-512 VNNI instruction sets.

The instance comes equipped with 256 GB of DDR4 memory clocked at 3 GHz, maintaining a 2 GB per vCPU ratio typical of compute-intensive configurations. Bundled directly into the hardware configuration are 7600 GB of high-speed local NVMe SSD storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 50 Gbps. No hardware GPUs are included with this server type.

Benchmark evaluations show top-tier multi-threaded compute, cryptography, and extended instruction performance, evidenced by a Passmark CPU score of 86,804.16 and encryption throughput reaching 110,784.01. Memory tests demonstrate strong bandwidth for large read blocks at 332.31 GB/sec. In application-level benchmarks, the instance achieves 106.99 million Redis SET operations per second and a static web serving throughput of 68.84 GB/sec. Single-core performance across stress-ng and Geekbench falls within the average tier.

With its pairing of dedicated 128 vCPUs and massive NVMe local storage, the c6id.32xlarge delivers solid resource density for high-throughput I/O and compute workloads. Workloads well matched to this architecture include distributed compilation, high-performance web caching, video encoding, real-time analytics, and transactional database systems requiring fast transient scratch space.
description: Amazon Web Services c6id.32xlarge is a compute-optimized instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor and a 3.5 GHz Intel Xeon 8375C processor. Built on the x86_64 architecture, it delivers 128 vCPUs across 64 physical cores, supported by 256 GB of DDR4 memory at a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. The server includes 7600 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD storage and 50 Gbps baseline networking, without discrete GPU hardware. Hardware support spans AVX-512, VNNI, and cryptographic extensions. Benchmarks reveal top-tier scores in multi-core compute, encryption, and extended instruction processing, accompanied by strong memory read bandwidth and over 106 million Redis SET operations per second. While single-thread execution rates reflect median performance, its compute density and fast local disk capacity provide balanced efficiency for data-intensive processing. The instance fits high-concurrency batch processing, Clang software builds, distributed caching, and database workloads requiring high IOPS and network throughput.
